title: CERTCRYPT Base Certificate (CCSP/1)
description: The shape of a CCSP/1 certificate. Passing this schema is necessary, not sufficient: the rules a schema cannot express are listed in `$comment` and decided by the verifier (duplicate member names, the calendar validity of `issued_at`, the recomputed digests and anchor commitment, the system and rules domain under evaluation, the admitted subject profiles, and the issuer signature itself).
$comment: Not expressible here and enforced by a conformant verifier: (1) no object repeats a member name, at any depth, after escape decoding (CCSP/1 §8.1) — a JSON value has already lost its duplicates; (2) issued_at names a real calendar instant; (3) payload.anchor_commitment_digest_hex, payload.anchor_canon_digest_hex and payload_canon_digest_hex equal their recomputation (CCCP/1 §7.3, §8.2); (4) payload.system_id and payload.rules_version are the system domain and a rules version the verifier evaluates under; (5) every subject profile is admitted by the rules domain; (6) the issuer signature declares the rules domain's profile and verifies.

metadata.description: Optional, unsigned, non-normative annotations. Never interpreted; hashed with the rest of the certificate by the emission binding.

extensions.description: Optional, unsigned, non-normative extensions keyed by namespaced names. Never interpreted; hashed with the rest of the certificate by the emission binding.

payload_canon_digest_hex.description: Optional publication of SHA3-256(JCS(payload)). Recomputed; a mismatch makes the certificate structurally invalid.

payload.description: The signed statement. Open: members not named here are allowed, except the reserved names.

anchor_canon_digest_hex.description: Optional publication of SHA3-256(JCS(anchor)). Recomputed; a mismatch makes the certificate structurally invalid.

system_id.description: The system domain the certificate is issued under.

rules_version.description: The rules domain the certificate is issued under.

signatures.description: Exactly one signature object: the issuer's composite signature.

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.fraction]Z, uppercase T and Z.

issuer_signature.description: The issuer's composite signature (composite-signature/1) over M' built from SHA3-256(JCS(payload)). Closed.

alg.description: Composite profile identifier. The rules domain fixes which one is admitted.

signatures.description: The two components, ECDSA P-256 first and ML-DSA-65 second (CCSP/1 §7.4.2).

id.description: Issuer-provided label; not an identity proof.

pub_p256_b64.description: P-256 public key, SEC1 uncompressed (65 bytes, 0x04 prefix), base64.

pub_mldsa_b64.description: ML-DSA-65 public key, raw FIPS 204 bytes, base64.
